contexts.text: Hence the serpent or Sensuous persuaded the woman to search the things which are of faith in the Lord as to whether they are so; which is signified by eating of the tree of knowledge.
If they eat of the fruit of the tree = that if from the Sensuous and Scientific, that is, from themselves, they search the things of faith...
And he searched, and found not the teraphim () = that they were not his. Explained.
They who love to be instructed... and for this end search the Scriptures...
They who constitute the province of the kidneys, etc... will nothing more than to explore and search of what quality others are. AC 5382.
The methods by which they explore or search the dispositions of others. Described.
From these things it is evident what is signified by its being said that Jehovah proveth and searcheth the reins and the heart...

When such read the Word, they search it merely with the end to confirm doctrinal scientifics, for the sake of gain; and many of them search the Word to see the nakedness of the land... But they who are in the affection of truth for the sake of truth and for the sake of life... have indeed faith in the doctrinals of the Church, but still they search the Word for the sake of no other end than the truth... [knowing] that the Word is to be searched with devout prayer to the Lord that there may be illustration.
And he searched () [for the cup] = investigation.
From this it is manifest that the Word is to be searched, and it is to be seen therein whether [doctrinal things] are true...

Wherefore it is to be denied to no one to search the Scriptures from the affection of knowing whether the doctrinal things of the Church into which he has been born are true; for otherwise he can never be illustrated.
Wherefore no one can search himself unless he knows what good is from its two loves, and also truth from good; and unless he knows what evil is from its two loves, and falsity from evil.

There are very many such [appearances] in the Word, which are manifest to any one who searches the Scriptures from the affection of truth, and for the sake of the good of life; because he is illustrated by the Lord.

When they arrive at an age when they begin to think for themselves, they search the Scriptures... for their know that without a searching of the Scripture from a genuine affection of truth, they would have remained in [any doctrine into which they might have been born].
Such are called searchers of heaven ().

That they who are in the affection of truth for the sake of truth, when they become adults... do not remain simply in the doctrinal things of their Church, but search whether they are true from the Word. References.
And thou hast explored those who say they are Apostles = that they search those things which in the Church are said to be goods and truths... AE 100.
I am He who searcheth the reins and the hearts () = that the Lord sees the quality of truth and of good with every one. AE 167.
Search himself once or twice a year...
The voice of a mill = inquiry, search, and confirmation of spiritual truth, especially from the Word.
That they who are in that Religiosity... have no inquiry, search, and confirmation of spiritual truth. Signified.
Philosophical inquiries from the understanding.
This may be clearly seen from a scrutiny and examination...
Without scrutiny into his quality as to his internal...
If he searches to find out whether he would do such things if fear... did not hinder, then after such scrutiny he... repents truly...
He who has not... looked into and searched himself, at last does not know what evil is... General article.
Those in scrutinies concerning the externals of the Word, and concerning its internals...
To search the heart () = to purify good by separating evil.
